gaps.reason: a field type's body is judged on the member A12 constructs from and on the two CONTENT laws measured beyond it — a `DateRangeType`'s (format, separator) pair, and an `EnumerationType`'s values against its categories. What a member otherwise holds is left to A12: a declared `format` outside the admitted vocabulary is refused there and cannot be reported here, since the admitted set is explicitly not closed and the refused one is a probe's universe rather than a law; a `CustomFieldType`'s `name` is judged on presence alone, and A12 refuses a no-break-space name in prose with no class this checker could cite

A12 refuses a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane in every text it validates as part of the model, with no class; this checker judges the carriers measured for it (a rule's and a computation's texts, a field's and a group's annotations, enum values and labels, a field type's own message, every element's path) and leaves the rest to A12 — a field type's other members, a category, the header, and a mounted provider's declarations

a rule's `errorCode` is judged on presence alone. A12's content law — "only letters, digits, blanks and underscores" — states its verdict in prose with no class this checker could cite, and which characters it counts as letters rests on a handful of rows (KERNEL-FINDINGS KF310), so a code such as `A-B` is left to A12. Re-open when this checker owns a code of its own for it

two entity filters sharing ONE argument list are treated as separate connective levels without a measurement saying they are — `SumOfProducts` is the only operator whose argument list takes two entity specs and it refuses a filter on either for a reason of its own, so no oracle for that shape exists. This is silence rather than a wrong verdict

a computation that READS its own computed field is refused by A12 and is not reported here: a projected read draws a different class than a plain one, and a derived-scale mismatch in the same operation pre-empts both — neither is decidable without inferring an operation's scale, which this checker does not do. Re-open when it can
only the families named by `CheckFamily` are implemented; every other required family of the pinned profile was not examined
